channel.title: Brian Bergstrom — Blog
channel.description: Weekly and biweekly GIS projects and write-ups from Brian Bergstrom: civic data journalism, humanitarian mapping, and personal-interest builds.

item.title: Chicago's Hidden Access Divide
item.description: Replicating a April 2026 PLOS ONE street-network study on Chicago for the first time, to find which neighborhoods have real services nearby AND a connected street grid, and which have only one or neither.

item.title: 10 Endangered Species, Mapped Honestly
item.description: Ten of the most endangered species in the U.S., each mapped with its own real, best-available metric, not one uniform number forced onto all of them.

item.title: Lake Ontario, or Lake America?
item.description: A single executive order renamed a Great Lake for U.S. Google Maps users. A real toggle map showing what changed, and why OpenStreetMap doesn't work that way.

item.title: Mapping the Response: The Rasuwa Flood
item.description: The real HOT/NAXA volunteer mapping response to the August 2026 Rasuwa flood in Nepal, alongside cloud-masked before/after satellite imagery and the real, still-rising toll.

item.title: Reportable Disease Cases Since RFK Jr. Took Over HHS
item.description: A national map of real, state-by-state case counts for every CDC-notifiable disease, tracked against the actual dated timeline of federal vaccine policy changes since RFK Jr. took over HHS.

item.title: How the United States Took Shape
item.description: A timelapse map of who actually controlled North American territory, 1492 to today: Indigenous nations, colonial powers, and the United States.

item.title: Chicagoland's Activity Space Divide
item.description: Testing a 2026 Demography paper's finding about shared activity space and segregation, at the Chicagoland municipality level.

item.title: Chicagoland Third Places
item.description: Every cafe, library, community center, and social facility across 319 Chicagoland municipalities, mapped per capita so towns of any size can be compared fairly.

item.title: Illinois Mental Health Map
item.description: County-level suicide rates, mental distress, and uninsured rates swiped directly against mental health facility locations across all 102 Illinois counties.

item.title: Illinois Turning Wood Map
item.description: Where 16 prized wood-turning species actually grow across Illinois, based on real USDA Forest Service survey data. Built for my uncle, a wood turner in the Chicago area.

item.title: Chicagoland Food Pantries & Transit Access
item.description: An interactive map of 285+ Chicago-area food pantries cross-referenced against real CTA, Metra, and Pace transit lines.

item.title: Canadian Wildfire Smoke Dashboard
item.description: A live, auto-updating dashboard tracking Canadian wildfire smoke and its impact on Chicago-area air quality.

item.title: Food Insecurity in DuPage County
item.description: A 2023 GIS capstone proving real food insecurity in one of the wealthiest counties in the country, now being rebuilt open-source at a 90-mile Chicago radius.

item.title: Hospital Accessibility Analysis
item.description: A live dashboard analyzing healthcare accessibility across Illinois, streaming cloud-native geospatial data in real time.

item.title: ICE Detention Facility Map
item.description: A dashboard mapping every U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facility and its reported population.

item.title: Illinois Weather Dashboard
item.description: Live precipitation and humidity across Illinois weather stations.

item.title: You Are Not Alone — NAMI DuPage StoryMap
item.description: A StoryMap built from 31 in-person community interviews, mapping mental health resources across DuPage County.

item.title: Chicagoland Transit Heat Vulnerability
item.description: A dashboard rating CTA stations by heat vulnerability in walkable zones, layering climate and demographic data.

item.title: DuPage Forest Preserve Trail & Tree Canopy Analyzer
item.description: Analyzes canopy cover and trail elevation across DuPage County Forest Preserves to find the shadiest walking routes.

item.title: Vampire Film Atlas
item.description: A temporal heat map of roughly 500 vampire and horror film locations across the U.S., 1960-2026.

item.title: World Religions Dashboard
item.description: A map of global religious distribution, with particular methodological care on Norse/Neopagan Ásatrú data.

item.title: World Cup Fatigue Dashboard
item.description: Tracks player and team fatigue across the 2026 World Cup, combining travel distance with days of rest between matches.
